title: Sebastian and the Summer
author: A. M. Quintana
blurb: Ines Winterbourne, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
